effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text and 1 card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
